articles.abstract_en: We develop a new class of two-stage mechanisms, which fully implement any social choice function under initial rationalizability in complete information environments. We show theoretically that our Simultaneous Report (SR) mechanisms are robust to small amounts of incomplete information about the state of nature. We also highlight the robustness of the mechanisms to a wide variety of reasoning processes and behavioral assumptions. We show experimentally that a SR mechanism performs well in inducing truth-telling in both complete and incomplete information environments and that it can induce efficient investment in a two-sided hold-up problem with ex-ante investment. The SR mechanism also outperforms a variety of other mechanisms proposed in the literature in terms of both efficiency and truth-telling rates and individuals are willing to use the mechanism when given the choice.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一类新的两阶段机制，在完全信息环境中，通过初始理性化，这类机制能够完全实施任何社会选择函数。我们从理论上证明，我们的同时报告（SR）机制对于关于自然状态的小量不完全信息具有稳健性。我们还强调了该机制对各种推理过程和行为假设的稳健性。我们通过实验表明，SR机制在完全和不完全信息环境中都能很好地诱导说真话，并且它能在具有事前投资的双边敲竹杠问题中诱导有效投资。SR机制在效率和说真话率方面也优于文献中提出的各种其他机制，并且当个体有选择时，他们愿意使用该机制。

articles.abstract_en: This paper investigates the sources of wage growth over the life cycle, determined by sectoral and firm mobility, unobserved ability, the accumulation of cognitive-abstract or routine-manual skills, and whether workers enroll in vocational training at the start of their career. Our analysis uses longitudinal administrative data over three decades and shows that routine-manual skills drive early wage growth, while cognitive-abstract skills become more important later. Moreover, job amenities are an important determinant of mobility decisions. Vocational training has long-term effects on career outcomes through various channels and generates returns for both the individual and society.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了生命周期中工资增长的来源，这些来源由部门和企业的流动性、未观测到的能力、认知抽象或常规手工技能的积累，以及工人是否在职业生涯开始时参加职业培训所决定。我们的分析使用了跨越三十年的纵向行政数据，并表明常规手工技能推动了早期的工资增长，而认知抽象技能在后期变得更加重要。此外，工作福利是流动性决策的重要决定因素。职业培训通过多种渠道对职业结果产生长期影响，并为个人和社会带来回报。

articles.title_en: Costless Information and Costly Verification: A Case for Transparency
articles.title_cn: 无成本信息与昂贵验证：透明性的理由
articles.abstract_en: A principal has to take a binary decision. She relies on information privately held by an agent who prefers the same action regardless of his type. The principal cannot incentivize with transfers but can learn the agent’s type at a cost. Additionally, the principal privately observes a signal correlated with the agent’s type. Transparent mechanisms are optimal: the principal’s payoff is the same as if her signal was public. A simple cutoff form is optimal: favorable signals ensure the agent’s preferred action. Signals below this cutoff lead to the nonpreferred action unless the agent appeals. An appeal always triggers type verification.
articles.abstract_cn: 委托人需要做出一个二元决策。她依赖于代理人私下持有的信息，而代理人无论其类型如何都偏好相同的行动。委托人无法通过转移支付进行激励，但可以花费成本了解代理人的类型。此外，委托人私下观察到一个与代理人类型相关的信号。透明机制是最优的：委托人的收益与她信号公开时相同。一个简单的截断形式是最优的：有利信号确保代理人偏好的行动。低于此截断的信号导致非偏好行动，除非代理人提出申诉。申诉总是触发类型验证。

articles.title_en: Large-Scale Education Reform in General Equilibrium: Regression Discontinuity Evidence from India
articles.title_cn: 一般均衡中的大规模教育改革：来自印度的断点回归证据
articles.abstract_en: The economic consequences of large-scale government investments in education depend on general equilibrium effects in both the labor market and the education sector. I develop a general equilibrium model capturing the consequences of massive countrywide schooling initiatives. I provide unbiased estimates of the model’s elasticities, using a regression discontinuity derived from Indian government policy. The earnings returns to a year of education are 13.4%, and the general equilibrium labor market effects substantially depress returns, by 6.6 percentage points. These general equilibrium effects have distributional consequences across cohorts and skill groups, whereby unskilled workers are better off and skilled workers worse off.
articles.abstract_cn: 大规模政府教育投资的经济后果取决于劳动力市场和教育部门的一般均衡效应。我构建了一个一般均衡模型，用以捕捉全国性大规模教育倡议的后果。我利用印度政府政策产生的断点回归，提供了模型弹性的无偏估计。一年教育的收益回报为13.4%，而一般均衡劳动力市场效应使回报大幅下降，降幅为6.6个百分点。这些一般均衡效应对不同队列和技能群体产生了分配性后果，其中非技术工人状况改善，而技术工人状况恶化。
